description: Map a Godot 4 project from its files, without running Godot: scenes with node trees, scripts with class_name, signals, functions and exports, autoloads, input actions, key settings, and broken references. Call this first in a project, and again after large changes. For one name use godot_usages; for engine classes use godot_api. `detail` brief gives one line per scene and script; full adds node trees with line numbers, signal connections, input events and settings. Read-only. Returns an error when there is no project.godot at or above `path`.

detail.description: brief: short output with capped lists; full: everything (default for this cheap profile: brief).

path.description: The project folder, or any file or folder inside it (Godotwright walks up to project.godot). Relative paths start at the server's folder. Default: the current project.

name: godot_scan
title: Map the Godot project
